extracted.name: Air Fryer Zucchini
extracted.description: This air fryer zucchini recipe is a quick, easy, and delicious side dish! The zucchini is tender, caramelized, and flavorful, thanks to a simple garlic and herb seasoning.
ingredient_lines: 1 pound zucchini (about 3 medium, cut into 1-inch half-moons)
instruction_lines: Preheat the air fryer to 400°F, if your air fryer requires preheating.
In a large bowl, toss the zucchini with the olive oil, Italian seasoning, salt, garlic powder, and several grinds of pepper.

Working in batches if necessary, arrange the zucchini in a single layer in the air fryer basket, leaving a little space between pieces. Air fry for 9 to 11 minutes, or until tender and browned around the edges. Repeat as necessary with the remaining zucchini.
Season to taste and serve topped with freshly grated Parmesan, if desired.
